sustainableFarming.title: Sustainable farming
sustainableFarming.text: Organic, sustainable fertilisers backed by our own laboratory and an environmental commitment.

innovation.title: Technological innovation
innovation.text: Technical solutions tailored to each crop, developed with research centres.

presence.title: Presence and commitment
presence.text: From Valencia, we work for agriculture aligned with the 2030 Agenda.

research.title: Agricultural R&D
research.text: We develop effective products based on real agronomic studies.

hero.title: Natural nutrition for healthy crops
hero.intro: At Clavel we develop sustainable agricultural solutions, with experience, innovation and a commitment to the future of farming.

lab.title: Our own laboratory and technology
lab.text: Our centre offers advanced technology, a specialised team and high-quality processes to deliver precise, reliable results. If you would like detailed information about our services, technical advice or personal support, we are here to help.

manufacturing.title: Manufacturing process
manufacturing.text1: Our efficient, technologically advanced manufacturing processes guarantee high-quality products. Our production system responds quickly to market needs, optimising time and resources.
manufacturing.text2: Integrated logistics ensure a continuous flow of materials and on-time delivery to any destination. From planning to final distribution, we work to strict standards to offer a reliable, safe and competitive service.

cta.title: Want to know our products?
cta.text: Ask us for the catalogue and we will email it to you, with full technical information on every fertiliser.

aboutUs.title: We grow trust, innovation and sustainability
aboutUs.intro: At Clavel we work alongside farmers every day, offering effective solutions that respect the environment.

mission.title: Mission
mission.text: We promote sustainable agriculture using natural, biodegradable substances that strengthen the plant–microorganism relationship and respect the balance of the environment.

goals.title: Goals
goals.text: Improve crop productivity and quality, increase plant resistance, guarantee zero residues and protect the environment.

purpose.title: Purpose
purpose.text: Our products improve plant growth and protection, strengthen roots and fruit, increase stress resistance and help preserve quality after harvest.

aboutUs.whyIntro: The main benefits our products and experience bring to farmers and their crops.

quality.title: Certified organic quality
quality.text: The up-to-date technology and biological substances we use in manufacturing, validated by our quality-control laboratory, guarantee efficiency and excellent results in the field.

organic.title: Organic is better
organic.text: Our concentrated organic fertilisers deliver better yield and quality while using less product and reducing waste. We also design personalised plans to optimise each crop, contributing to sustainable, efficient agriculture.

news.title: News from the field and from Clavel

erasmusLaboratory.excerpt: Four Erasmus students join our R&D and laboratory team in Valencia to take part in applied research projects.

agenda2030.title: The 2030 Agenda and sustainable agriculture
agenda2030.excerpt: The UN 2030 Agenda sets the path towards a fairer future that respects the planet. Agriculture plays a key role.

soilQuality.title: How to improve soil quality and boost productivity
soilQuality.excerpt: A successful harvest starts underground. Why enriching the soil before sowing matters and how to do it step by step.

trialFields.excerpt: Trial fields are essential to validate organic fertilisers against conventional agriculture.

soilPreparation.title: Soil preparation in organic farming
soilPreparation.excerpt: Seven key steps to a healthy crop: well-worked soil retains water better and provides the nutrients plants need.

team.title: The people behind Clavel
team.intro: A small, approachable team with experience in agronomy, laboratory work and farmer support.

privacyPolicy.title: Privacy policy
privacyPolicy.intro: What data we collect through this website, what we use it for and what rights you have.
privacyPolicy.lead: At Clavel we take the protection of your personal data seriously. We process it in accordance with Regulation (EU) 2016/679, the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR), and Spanish Organic Law 3/2018 on the Protection of Personal Data and the Guarantee of Digital Rights (LOPDGDD).

controller.title: Data controller
controller.text: The controller of your data is {{company}}, with registered address at {{address}}. You can contact us at {{email}} or by phone on {{phone}}.

data.title: What data we collect
data.text: Only the data you give us in the contact form: full name, email address and, if you choose to provide them, company or farm, phone number and the message you write to us.

purpose.title: What we use it for
purpose.text: To answer your enquiry and send you the catalogue or the product information you request. We do not use it to send you commercial communications you have not requested or to build profiles.

legalBasis.title: Legal basis
legalBasis.text: Your consent, which you give us by ticking the box on the form. You can withdraw it at any time, without affecting the lawfulness of the processing carried out before its withdrawal.

retention.title: How long we keep it
retention.text: For as long as necessary to handle your enquiry and, afterwards, for the periods required by law to deal with any possible liabilities.

recipients.title: Recipients
recipients.text: We do not share your data with third parties unless required by law. Providers of technical services, such as email or website hosting, only access it to provide that service to us and with the safeguards required by the GDPR.

rights.title: Your rights
rights.text: You can exercise your rights of access, rectification, erasure, objection, restriction of processing and portability by writing to us at {{email}}. If you consider that we have not handled your request properly, you can lodge a complaint with the Spanish Data Protection Agency (www.aepd.es).
